name: bug-issue-writer
description: Delegate maintainer issue drafts to subagents and summarize expected versus actual behavior in a bug overview.

interface.shortDescription: Create maintainer issues and a concise bug overview.
interface.longDescription: Delegates issue writing to subagents using the existing source, complete tests, and original logs. The parent agent reviews each report and produces BUG-OVERVIEW.md with expected and actual behavior, impact, root cause, and links to the final reports. Includes issue and overview templates, a user-approved issue example, and interrupted-task recovery guidance.
defaultPrompt: 使用 $bug-issue-writer，调用 subagent 根据现有证据生成 issue，并汇总 BUG-OVERVIEW.md。
